nodes.text: The outbreak is suspected to be linked to human metapneumovirus (HMPV), a virus that causes mild to moderate flu-like symptoms but can lead to severe conditions in kid and elderly. Like other respiratory viruses like RSV, HMPV spreads thru respiratory droplets and close contact.
